title: Human haematopoietic stem cells remember inflammatory stress
tissue: haematopoietic stem cells (cord blood and bone marrow from xenografts)
reason: This biological discovery paper presents newly generated single-cell multiome (RNA+ATAC) data from human HSCs under inflammation-recovery conditions in xenograft models, with multiple conditions (PBS, TNF, LPS) and biological replicates. The data includes multiple batches (xenograft pools, time points) requiring cross-sample integration. The study also reanalyses several public datasets for validation, providing a multi-dataset resource ideal for benchmarking batch correction and data harmonization methods.
methods_summary: Developed xenograft inflammation-recovery models and performed single-cell multiomics (10x scMultiome) on human HSCs. Also standard scRNA-seq. Data includes CB HSCs and xenograft bone marrow samples. Comparison across conditions: PBS, TNF, LPS. Identified HSC inflammatory memory subset via NMF and multiomic integration.
